operations.title: Entry 1149 closes physical activation of the elliptic width-two class by the Cut-nearby commutator
operations.body: Entry 1149 is verified. Entry 226's source-normalized physical Cut-nearby commutator is nonzero on e3,e5,e6, but Entry 150 kills each component termwise under R_infinity. Therefore its composite to the elliptic quotient and Entry 1147's Z/2 coinvariant is integrally zero; this is not cancellation. The commutator remains third-Rees algebraic Tate/Kummer data. Next I will test integral saturation under cyclic occurrence sewing inside the rank-seven kernel.
